name: Treasure Hunting -Claire no Bitch na Bouken-
original_name: トレジャーハンティング—クレアのビッチな冒険—
source:
There are relics from past ages yet undiscovered. 
Treasures from lost worlds that beckon to 
a certain types of people. Explorers. Archaeologists. 

Treasure hunters 

One such huntress has short cropped hair, 
womanly round hips and a hypersensitive big clitoris. 

Claire. 

She has cum to find the riches of a tribal clan 
that is said to have mastered the science of alchemy. 

Into the ancient village she penetrated. Claire was 
praised as a goddess among the simple people, but 
she allowed herself to be part of a welcome ceremony. 
In this village, goddesses get gangbanged.
